description: Creates a new checklist on a Trello card, either by name or by copying from `idChecklistSource`, targeting an `idCard` or `idBoard`; this action creates only the checklist structure, not its items.

inputSchema.description: Parameters to create a new Trello checklist, including target card/board, optional source for copying, name (if not copying), and position.

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board. If `idCard` is not specified, this board will be targeted, potentially for creating a new card to host the checklist. One of `idBoard` or `idCard` is required.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idCard.description: The ID of the Trello card to which the checklist will be added. If provided, the checklist is added to this specific card. One of `idBoard` or `idCard` is required.
idCard.title: Id Card

idChecklistSource.description: The ID of an existing checklist to be copied. If provided, the `name` parameter is ignored, and the new checklist will be a duplicate of this source.
idChecklistSource.title: Id Checklist Source

name.description: The name for the new checklist. Required if `idChecklistSource` is not provided. Must be a string with length between 0 and 16384 characters.
name.title: Name

pos.description: The position of the new checklist on its card. Accepted values are 'top', 'bottom', or a positive number (integer or float).
pos.title: Pos

inputSchema.title: AddChecklistsRequest

name: add_checklists

AddChecklistsResponse.description: Response containing the data of the newly created Trello checklist.

checkItems.description: Array of check items within the checklist.
checkItems.title: Check Items

idBoard.description: Identifier of the board containing the checklist.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idCard.description: Identifier of the card to which the checklist belongs.
idCard.title: Id Card

pos.description: Position of the checklist relative to other checklists on the card.
pos.title: Pos

AddChecklistsResponse.title: AddChecklistsResponse

CheckItem.description: Represents a single check item within a checklist.

due.description: Due date for the check item in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.000Z). Available in Premium workspaces.
due.title: Due

id.description: Unique identifier of the check item.
id.title: Id

idMember.description: Identifier of the member assigned to the check item. Can be null. Available in Premium workspaces.
idMember.title: Id Member

name.description: Name or text content of the check item.
name.title: Name

pos.description: Position of the check item within the checklist.
pos.title: Pos

state.description: Completion state of the check item. Possible values: 'complete' or 'incomplete'.
state.title: State

CheckItem.title: CheckItem
